title: Complete Night Intelligence
summary: Night Roster now turns the selected shift into a focused command centre with attention, conflict, freshness, offline-confidence and troubleshooting intelligence around the existing safe roster workflow.
changes: Adds a Night Command Centre with My Night, shift phase, sync freshness, privacy-preserving presence, an Attention Inbox and a context-sensitive recommended next action.

Adds supported Undo surfacing, concurrent-edit review, roster conflict warnings, long-press person actions, Search & Commands, adaptive density and Calm Mode without creating a second clinical write path.

Makes roster notifications and app badges more meaningful, preserves deep links to the selected night and keeps offline use explicitly read-only with private reminders that never auto-submit shared changes.
Adds an in-app PWA Health Check, guided troubleshooting and accessibility fallbacks while preserving the existing shared Shift Identity and Personalisation Studio.
Ships the intelligence layer in the reviewed Pages bundle and installed-app cache with deterministic, real-browser, low-end and iPhone regression coverage.
